title: M2 outside-packet and endpoint assembly after the canonical hard top

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use accepted source-audited nodes. If a new source is proposed, use primary sources and audit the literal weight, range, endpoint, and uniformity hypotheses.

frozen_target.question: Assuming the canonical residual hard-top M2 theorem, which exact additional outside-packet estimates are necessary and sufficient to prove the full pointwise M9-M2 dyadic estimate?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Every literal M2 block B_2(D,L;X) must be O_epsilon(X^(1/4+epsilon)) on the active triangle, with bottom and R5 owned once and logarithmic assembly absorbed.
scope: build a physical one-count table before any implication
distinguish the single hard top band from smooth top-scale bands
separate proved reductions from proved estimates
retain all character, profile, floor, star, sign, and real-X endpoint data

completion_criteria: Construct the exact active-triangle owner table.
Split the residual set into hard top, smooth balanced, and smooth unbalanced packets.
Audit all physical endpoint and one-count seams.
Decide whether the canonical theorem alone implies M9-M2.
State the minimal conditional assembly theorem or exact smaller residual.
Classify legacy near-collision and fourth-moment dependencies as necessary or alternative.
Complete clean blind, analytic, and hostile reports.
Make one conductor decision without starting another core attack.

tasks.target: Independently construct the conditional M2 packet table and identify every outside survivor.
Prove the sharp conditional one-count assembly or isolate the minimal independent outside M2 packets.

review_seams.requirement: Check every physical D,L cell and residual phase-diagram inequality.
Give each bottom, residual, boundary, profile, and transform term exactly one owner.
Separate the hard top band from smooth top-scale bands and keep real-X floors.
